name: color-palette-generator
description: Build a color palette generator using the dream.js color library - tests real-world library integration

variants.typescript:
Create a TypeScript module that uses the dream.js color library (located at ../dream.js) to generate Material Design color palettes. Requirements:

1. Import necessary functions from dream.js:
   - Hct (color space)
   - themeFromSourceColor
   - Any other utilities needed

2. Create a PaletteGenerator class with:
   - generateFromColor(hexColor: string): ColorScheme
   - generateFromImage(imageData: ImageData): ColorScheme[]
   - exportAsCss(scheme: ColorScheme): string
   - exportAsJson(scheme: ColorScheme): object

3. Proper TypeScript interfaces:
   - ColorScheme interface
   - PaletteOptions interface
   - Export types

4. Error handling for invalid colors

5. Export the class and all types

Note: The dream.js library provides Material Design 3 color utilities based on HCT color space.
variants.javascript:
Create a JavaScript module that uses the dream.js color library to generate Material Design color palettes. Requirements:

1. Import from dream.js (Hct, themeFromSourceColor, etc.)

2. Create a PaletteGenerator class with:
   - generateFromColor(hexColor)
   - generateFromImage(imageData)
   - exportAsCss(scheme)
   - exportAsJson(scheme)

3. Error handling for invalid colors

4. Export the class

Same functionality as TypeScript version.
variants.javascript-jsdoc:
Create a JavaScript module with JSDoc that uses the dream.js color library. Requirements:

1. Complete JSDoc type definitions:
   - @typedef ColorScheme
   - @typedef PaletteOptions
   - @typedef HctColor

2. PaletteGenerator class with full JSDoc:
   - Document all methods with @param and @return
   - Use @template where appropriate

3. Same functionality as other variants

4. Export with JSDoc @exports
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a color palette generator web application using dream.js. Include:

**HTML:**
- Color input field
- Image upload button
- Generated palette display (color swatches)
- Export buttons (CSS, JSON)
- Preview section showing colors

**CSS:**
- Modern, clean design
- Color swatches in a grid
- Hover effects on swatches
- Copy-to-clipboard visual feedback

**JavaScript:**
- Import and use dream.js library
- Generate palette from hex color input
- Extract colors from uploaded image
- Display color swatches with hex values
- Click to copy color values
- Export as CSS variables
- Export as JSON

**Features:**
- Real-time palette generation
- Visual color preview
- Material Design 3 compliant colors
- Accessible color combinations

Return as single HTML file or clear structure. Must actually use the dream.js library functions.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Same as javascript-vanilla-web but with:
- Complete JSDoc for all functions
- @typedef for all data structures
- Document the dream.js integration
- Type-safe callback functions
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a color palette generator using TypeScript and dream.js with vanilla Web APIs:

**TypeScript:**
- Import dream.js types
- Type-safe color handling
- Proper DOM typing
- Interface for app state

**Features:**
- Type-safe event handlers
- Generic color utilities
- Strongly-typed palette generation
- Type-safe exports (CSS, JSON)

**HTML/CSS:**
- Modern UI design
- Responsive layout
- Color accessibility indicators

Provide TypeScript source and HTML structure.
variants.typescript-react:
Create a color palette generator using TypeScript React and dream.js:

**Components:**
- App (main container)
- ColorInput (hex input with validation)
- ImageUploader (upload and extract colors)
- PaletteDisplay (show generated colors)
- ColorSwatch (individual color with copy)
- ExportPanel (CSS/JSON export buttons)

**Custom Hooks:**
- usePalette (manages palette state)
- useColorExtractor (extract from images)
- useClipboard (copy to clipboard)

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for ColorScheme from dream.js
- Props types for all components
- Type-safe dream.js integration

**Features:**
- Real-time palette generation
- Image color extraction
- Copy colors to clipboard
- Export functionality
- Material Design 3 compliant

Minimal deps (React + dream.js only).

testCases.name: Class instantiation
testCases.test: const generator = new PaletteGenerator(); console.assert(typeof generator === 'object', 'Generator should be an object');

testCases.name: Generate from color
testCases.test: const generator = new PaletteGenerator(); const scheme = generator.generateFromColor('#FF0000'); console.assert(scheme && typeof scheme.primary === 'number', 'Scheme should have a numeric primary color');

testCases.name: Export to CSS
testCases.test: const generator = new PaletteGenerator(); const scheme = generator.generateFromColor('#0000FF'); const css = generator.exportAsCss(scheme); console.assert(typeof css === 'string' && css.includes('--md-sys-color-primary'), 'CSS export should be a string with CSS variables');
